recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if CDS adopts a new realization model that replaces the current Task.focus guidance for computed event resources.
issue_request: FHIR-29209 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked how Clinical Reasoning PlanDefinition/ActivityDefinition could generate event resources such as Observation or RiskAssessment when ActivityDefinition.kind cannot generate event resources directly. The accepted resolution was to add guidance from comments in the definitional-artifacts topic and link from PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition realization topics.
initial_application: Commit 5126624496f45455a6dbaf65bfc5c7d44f4f367e, cited in the Jira comments with PR HL7/fhir#2834, added Event Resources guidance to ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition narrative, updated ActivityDefinition.kind commentary, and expanded the Clinical Reasoning definitional-resources page to say event resources should be represented through a Task with proposal intent and Task.focus set to the computed event resource.
additional_context: FHIR Workflow minutes from 2021-01-11 and 2021-02-08 confirm that the intended result was a Task saying to store the Observation because the output remains a proposed request. Later Applied issue FHIR-49988 retained and generalized Task realization for PlanDefinition.action.definition references to other definitional resources after implementer feedback opposed removing those references.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini; their current realization narratives contain the Event Resources guidance; ActivityDefinition.kind still documents the Request-only rule and Task.focus workaround; and the Clinical Reasoning module links to the definitional-resources page that contains the Task/proposal guidance.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied CDS issue retained Task as the realization strategy for PlanDefinition references to definitional resources other than ActivityDefinition or PlanDefinition.
